role: The Knockback enchantment (effect id 19, weapon type): level windows and max level in the shared registry.
scope_reason: The enchanting table is a plain block (world.conf enchanting=off), but the enchantment registry itself is kept: loot books and mob equipment carry enchantments (DEVLOG 2026-09-25, 'Kept: enchantment data and effects').

members.name: EnchantmentKnockback
members.note: setName('knockback') is the row's name field

notes: The effect the enchantment applies is read by the mob attack path: hostiles_pigman.c:attack_entity_as_mob reads effect 19 off the pigman's held gear; the player attack path (combat.c) does not read a held item's knockback level. The level is read by combatench.c:ench_knockback for the player's and every mob's melee.
